title: Kelechek market traders rally against municipal relocation
scope: One local market-relocation rally; no broader multi-location campaign is established.
organizer: Unknown; sources do not name an organizer.

state_target.target: Osh municipal relocation decision; participants also appealed to the President and GKNB chair.
state_target.evidence: The direct target was municipal market relocation; participants also appealed to the President and GKNB chair.

demands_original: Keep the market at its existing location and allow traders to continue working there.
participants_original: Unknown; the reported 6–7 thousand refers to jobs at the market, not rally attendees.
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous crowd estimate; the ≥50 threshold is unestablished.

start_date.summary: Both opened reports date the Kelechek market rally to July 17, 2025.

end_date.summary: Neither report states when the gathering ended or whether it continued later.

location.summary: Both identify the Kelechek clothing market in Osh; exact assembly spot is not specified.

scope.summary: Reports describe a local rally opposing relocation; no linked action in another city is established.

organizer.summary: Neither report identifies a named organizer.

state_target.summary: The direct target was municipal market relocation; participants also appealed to the President and GKNB chair.

demands.summary: Participants asked that the market remain at its existing site and traders be allowed to continue working there.

participants_original.summary: Both reports lack a demonstrator count; 6–7 thousand is reported as market employment, not turnout.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No evidence establishes at least 50 people present simultaneously; threshold is unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: Report.kg and Kaktus characterize the rally as peaceful; broader violence coding remains unknown.

state_response.summary: No event-time state response, concession or final outcome is reported.

notes: Two same-day stories have near-identical headline/quotes; independence is unknown and they are not counted as independent corroboration.
open_questions: Were at least 50 people present simultaneously?
Was the gathering part of a continuing action, and when did it end?
Who organized it and what was the final municipal response?
